summary: The audit checks the introductory physics courses (the renumbered labs count under either number), MATH 51-53 or 61CM-63CM, and two more advanced physics courses from the list, 36 units in all. Every course must be letter graded with a C- or better, except the introductory courses offered only S/NC. Checked by hand: waivers of PHYSICS 41 or 43 after the placement diagnostic, and petitions to substitute math or introductory physics courses.

lpJzguih.why: Notes: "Physics 79L - This course was offered as PHYSICS 89L prior to Academic Year 2025-2026. Students requiring 89L credit may use this course to satisfy that requirement." "Physics 81L - This course is new to the department as of the Academic Year 2025-2026. Students requiring credit for 71L may take this course to satisfy that requirement."

program.why: Grading: "All courses for the Physics minor must be taken for a letter grade, and a grade of C- or better must be received for all units applied toward the minor, with the following exceptions: a grade of S is acceptable for PHYSICS 41, 61, 61L, 71L (or 81L), and 89L (or 79L)." Those courses are offered only S/NC, which the letter-grade rule allows.
